name: MR. ARJUN MEHTA
narrative: Healthy saver. High savings rate, disciplined SIPs, adequate insurance, card paid in full monthly. Baseline for comparison.

name: MS. MEERA NAIR
narrative: Irregular income. Some months two client payments, some months none. Tests cash-flow volatility, advance tax, and whether the app can compute a meaningful savings rate without a fixed salary.

name: MR. ROHIT BANSAL
narrative: Revolving credit card debt. Pays only the minimum, so finance charges compound month over month. Two cards, one loan stack. This is the persona the app should flag most loudly.

name: MS. SNEHA IYER
narrative: First job. No emergency fund, no term or health cover beyond employer group policy, seven active subscriptions, heavy food delivery. Card carries a partial balance most months.

name: MR. VIKRAM RAO
narrative: High earner, thin savings rate. Rent and discretionary spending scaled with income. Large card balance carried at a low utilisation ratio, so it looks fine on the surface and is not.
